title: Back to Yours
premise: A dinner party has just ended. The listener and Jasper, established adults in a new relationship, take the long way home through quiet streets.
beats: Leaving the party: recap the evening's private jokes, the looks across the table.
The detour: he admits the route home is not the fast one, and why.
The doorstep: unhurried, warm, asking rather than assuming.
Inside: banter softens into closeness; explicit verbal check-in before anything more.
